name: Japan map 15 km historical: 200-turn health run with every JAC PoC mod (OUCHI human), summary every 50 turns (read-only tuning observations and turn metrics)

steps.code:
local function S(v) return tostring(v) end
local turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1
local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
local api=ExposedMembers.JAC_UnificationCastles
if not api then error('unification castle reader missing') end
local castles=api.CountedCities()
local held={}
for _,c in ipairs(castles) do local id=c:GetOwner(); held[id]=(held[id] or 0)+1 end
local era=GameInfo.Eras[Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()]
if not era then error('current engine era missing') end
local out={'checkpoint turn='..turn..' era='..era.EraType..' targets='..#castles}
for row in GameInfo.Eras_XP2() do
  if row.EraType==era.EraType then
    out[#out+1]='era-values grievances='..S(row.GrievanceDecayRate)..' tensions='..S(row.TensionDecayRate)..' trade-minimum-change='..S(row.TradeRouteMinimumEndTurnChange)
  end
end
for id=0,21 do
  local p=Players[id]
  local c=PlayerConfigurations[id]
  local h=type(l)=='table' and l.houses and l.houses['p'..id] or nil
  out[#out+1]='house player='..id..' civ='..S(c and c:GetCivilizationTypeName())..' alive='..S(p and p:IsAlive())..' cities='..S(p and p:GetCities():GetCount())..' castles='..(held[id] or 0)..' legitimacy='..S(p and p:GetProperty('JAC_LEGITIMACY'))..' age='..S(h and h.age)..' policy='..S(h and h.policy)..' pact-lead='..S(Game:GetProperty('JAC_UNIFICATION_PACT_LEAD_'..id))
end
return table.concat(out,' ; ')

local w,h=Map.GetGridSize(); if w~=204 or h~=88 then error('map grid mismatch '..w..'x'..h) end; if #PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()~=22 then error('initial major count') end; local cities=0; for i=0,21 do cities=cities+Players[i]:GetCities():GetCount() end; if cities~=56 then error('initial city count '..cities) end; return '15 km historical map: 22 majors, 56 cities'

if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset') end; local t,c=0,0; for row in GameInfo.Technologies() do t=t+1; if not string.find(row.TechnologyType,'TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official tech: '..row.TechnologyType) end end; for row in GameInfo.Civics() do c=c+1; if not string.find(row.CivicType,'CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_',1,true) then error('official civic: '..row.CivicType) end end; if t~=32 or c~=30 then error('wrong tree counts '..t..'/'..c) end; if GameInfo.Eras['ERA_ANCIENT'].Name~='LOC_JAC_ERA_TENBUN_NAME' then error('Sengoku era missing') end; if not GameClimate or not GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange or not Game.GetWorldCongress then error('GS core APIs missing') end; if GameClimate.GetTemperatureChange()==nil or not Game.GetWorldCongress() then error('GS systems inactive') end; return '32 techs, 30 civics, GS systems present'

-- S(v): tostring(v) that survives calls returning no value (Lua 5.1 errors on zero-arg tostring)
local function S(v) return tostring(v) end
local ok, r = pcall(function()
local start, turn = GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn(), Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
local function Name(i) local c = PlayerConfigurations[i]; return c and (string.gsub(c:GetCivilizationTypeName() or ('P' .. i), 'CIVILIZATION_JAC_', '')) or ('P' .. i) end
local alive, dead, cities = 0, {}, {}
for i = 0, 21 do local p = Players[i]; if p and p:IsAlive() then alive = alive + 1; cities[#cities + 1] = Name(i) .. '=' .. p:GetCities():GetCount() else dead[#dead + 1] = Name(i) end end
local ages = 'none'
local l = Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
if type(l) == 'table' then
  local reigns = {}
  for row in GameInfo.JAC_SengokuReigns() do reigns[#reigns + 1] = row end
  table.sort(reigns, function(a, b) if a.Year ~= b.Year then return a.Year < b.Year end; if a.Month ~= b.Month then return a.Month < b.Month end; return a.ReignType < b.ReignType end)
  local n = { GOLDEN = 0, NORMAL = 0, DARK = 0, HEROIC = 0 }
  local h = l.reign and l.history and l.history['r' .. l.reign]
  if type(h) == 'table' then for k, v in pairs(h) do if string.sub(k, 1, 1) == 'p' and type(v) == 'table' and n[v.age] then n[v.age] = n[v.age] + 1 end end end
  local reign = (l.reign or 0) > 0 and reigns[l.reign] and reigns[l.reign].ReignType or 'START'
  ages = 'reign=' .. S(l.reign) .. ':' .. reign .. ' last(G/N/D/H)=' .. n.GOLDEN .. '/' .. n.NORMAL .. '/' .. n.DARK .. '/' .. n.HEROIC
end
local arb = { pending = 0, truce = 0, await = 0, peace = 0, outlaw = 0 }
if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_PENDING') ~= nil then arb.pending = 1 end
for a = 0, 21 do
  local pa = Players[a]; if pa and pa:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_OUTLAW_UNTIL') ~= nil then arb.outlaw = arb.outlaw + 1 end
  for b = a + 1, 21 do
    local s = a .. '_' .. b
    if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_TRUCE_' .. s) ~= nil then arb.truce = arb.truce + 1 end
    if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_AWAIT_' .. s) ~= nil then arb.await = arb.await + 1 end
    if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_PEACE_TURN_' .. s) ~= nil then arb.peace = arb.peace + 1 end
  end
end
local arbText = 'arb pending=' .. arb.pending .. ' truce=' .. arb.truce .. ' await=' .. arb.await .. ' peace=' .. arb.peace .. ' outlaw=' .. arb.outlaw .. ' lastReq=' .. S(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_LAST_REQUEST_TURN'))
return 'T+' .. (turn - start + 1) .. ' engine=' .. turn .. ' alive=' .. alive .. ' dead=[' .. table.concat(dead, ',') .. '] cities=[' .. table.concat(cities, ',') .. '] ages ' .. ages .. ' events=' .. S(Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT') or 0) .. ' alliances=' .. (function() local n, m = 0, PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors(); for i = 1, #m do for j = i + 1, #m do if m[i]:GetDiplomacy():HasAllied(m[j]:GetID()) then n = n + 1 end end end; return n end)() .. ' ' .. arbText .. ' winner=' .. S(Game.GetWinningTeam())
end)
return ok and r or ('summary failed: ' .. S(r))

local ok, r = pcall(function()
local turn = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
local eras, sum, bad = Game.GetEras(), 0, {}
for _, p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do
  local id, s = p:GetID(), 0
  for _, src in ipairs(eras:GetPlayerCurrentEraScoreBreakdown(id) or {}) do for _, v in pairs(src) do if type(v) == 'number' then s = s + v end end end
  if s ~= 0 then bad[#bad + 1] = id .. '=' .. s end
  sum = sum + s
end
return 'year=' .. S(Calendar.MakeYearStr(turn)) .. ' localPlayer=' .. Game.GetLocalPlayer() .. ' officialEraScore=' .. sum .. (sum == 0 and ' OK' or (' NONZERO [' .. table.concat(bad, ',') .. ']'))
end)
return ok and r or ('summary failed: ' .. S(r))

for a = 0, 21 do
  local pa = Players[a]; if pa and pa:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_OUTLAW_UNTIL') ~= nil then arb.outlaw = arb.outlaw + 1 end
  for b = a + 1, 21 do
    local s = a .. '_' .. b
    if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_TRUCE_' .. s) ~= nil then arb.truce = arb.truce + 1 end
    if Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_AWAIT_' .. s) ~= nil then arb.await = arb.await + 1 end

  end
end

' events=' .. S(Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT') or 0) .. ' alliances=' .. (function() local n, m = 0, PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors(); for i = 1, #m do for j = i + 1, #m do if m[i]:GetDiplomacy():HasAllied(m[j]:GetID()) then n = n + 1 end end end; return n end)() .. ' ' .. arbText .. ' winner=' .. S(Game.GetWinningTeam())
end)

-- S(v): tostring(v) that survives calls returning no value (Lua 5.1 errors on zero-arg tostring)
local function S(v) return tostring(v) end

local turn = Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
local eras, sum, bad = Game.GetEras(), 0, {}

  if s ~= 0 then bad[#bad + 1] = id .. '=' .. s end
  sum = sum + s
end
return 'year=' .. S(Calendar.MakeYearStr(turn)) .. ' localPlayer=' .. Game.GetLocalPlayer() .. ' officialEraScore=' .. sum .. (sum == 0 and ' OK' or (' NONZERO [' .. table.concat(bad, ',') .. ']'))
end)
